notes: Container-unit ingredients went 30 -> 25. Every B&E per-bag dry good is now confirmed and costed per gram; none of the five weights was guessed.

Of the remaining 25: 4 are packaging (Carry Bag - Paper, Burger Box Hard/Soft, Snack Box - Hard) which Zak elected on 2026-08-14 to leave in the picker. Several more are legitimately countable units a chef can use as-is (punnets of blackberries, edible flowers, micro herbs). The genuinely broken ones are boxes of loose produce sold by weight - FFT Baby Gem, Broccolini, Baby Spinach English, 'Large' (Carrot Large) - which need the Fresh Fruit Team catalogue.
Fresh Fruit Team's portal (thefreshfruitteamptyltd.shop.bossqi.app) requires a login, so those could not be confirmed this run. If Zak signs in and leaves the tab open they can be done in one pass.
B&E's catalogue sits behind Cloudflare. It clears on its own if you WAIT (~15-20s) rather than retrying; retrying re-triggers the challenge. Noted for the next run.

pack_overrides.yaml is an append-only log where the LAST entry per id wins - repeated ids are the design, not a defect. select-fresh:MUSB currently resolves to 4000 g ($9.13/kg), from an entry attributed to the FFT catalogue rather than Select Fresh's own. The number is plausible but the provenance is cross-supplier inference; worth a confirm if mushroom cost ever looks off.
